Pushdowns already put only light stress on the elbow, and no other triceps exercise is any easier on it. I'd skip triceps today and let the elbow settle.

⚠️ Keep your pressing pain-free too, and lower the weight if it flares up. If the pain is sharp or sticks around, get it checked by a professional.
